headline: Colonial Post Returns in Weathered Expanse as Palantine Berm Leads the Fray
war_summary: Fighting has not settled in the north. Weathered Expanse, reported wholly Warden with three works unclaimed at the last edition, now shows a Colonial post standing again beside six Warden works and two neutral; the field logged thirty-seven ownership actions in a day, five of them within two hours, around Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest. Its casualty rolls remain the war's heaviest, near nine thousand Colonial and ten thousand Warden in twenty-four hours. Linn Mercy, the busiest field a day ago, now reads nine Colonial works, one Warden and one neutral, with thirty-six actions and sixteen inside six hours; Lathair and Outwich Ranch absorb the weight, and the day's tolls run near nine thousand eight hundred Colonial against sixteen thousand seven hundred Warden. Palantine Berm leads all fields at forty-seven actions, four Colonial works to three Warden, Vendett and Windburn Landing the points of contact. Marban Hollow counts twenty-nine, almost all at Checkpoint Bua, standing four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral. Gutter logs fourteen around Lost Kaivo and Suojus; Stonecradle thirteen, seven in the past two hours, at The Dais. Thirty-four towns are still required for victory.
